package.name: super_lio_bridge
package.description: Bridges Super-LIO into this Nav2 stack: splits Super-LIO's single world -> imu TF into the map -> odom -> base_footprint chain Nav2 needs, republishes its cloud as /registered_scan, and publishes /localization/tracking_ok for the safety layer. Talks to Super-LIO only over topics/TF (no headers, no linking), so Super-LIO's GPLv3 does not affect this package and it builds without Super-LIO present.
